tools.name: get_occupancy
tools.description: Get today's occupancy metrics including occupancy percentage, total arrivals, total departures, and available rooms for the property. Optionally accepts a date to query a specific day.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

date.description: ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD) to query. Defaults to today if not provided.

tools.name: get_revenue
tools.description: Get revenue key performance indicators including ADR (Average Daily Rate), RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room), and comparisons versus budget and prior periods.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

start_date.description: ISO 8601 start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the revenue period. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 end date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the revenue period. Defaults to start_date.

tools.name: get_vip_guests
tools.description: Get VIP guest arrivals and currently in-house VIP guests for the property. Returns guest names, loyalty tier, room assignment, and any noted occasion.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

date.description: ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for VIP arrivals. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_room_status
tools.description: Get current room status including rooms out of order, out of service, or awaiting housekeeping. Returns room numbers, issue descriptions, and duration.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

tools.name: get_work_orders
tools.description: Get open and overdue maintenance work orders for the property. Returns work order IDs, descriptions, priority levels, and age in hours.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

status.description: Filter by status. Must be one of: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS. If not provided, returns both open and in-progress.

tools.name: get_sister_property_availability
tools.description: Get sister properties (other properties of the same brand) that currently have room availability, optionally for a given stay-date range and room type. Used to relocate walked guests when a property is oversold. Returns each sister property with its count of available rooms.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

startDate.description: ISO 8601 stay start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Echoed for context; availability is derived from current AVAILABLE room inventory.

endDate.description: ISO 8601 stay end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to startDate when omitted.

roomType.description: Optional room type to match (e.g. SUITE, KING_DELUXE, KING_STANDARD).

tools.name: get_walkable_guests
tools.description: Get confirmed guests eligible to be walked when a night is oversold, ordered lowest-loyalty first and capped at the room shortfall. Only guests whose loyalty tier is at or below the protection threshold are returned.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

shortfall.description: Number of rooms oversold - the maximum number of walkable guests to return.

loyaltyProtectionTier.description: Guests at or below this tier are walkable. One of PLATINUM, TITANIUM, AMBASSADOR. Defaults to PLATINUM (least-elite only).

arrivalDate.description: ISO 8601 arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the oversold night. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_room_move_candidates
tools.description: Get rooms that are ready and available for reassignment, for example to move a VIP guest whose assigned room is not ready. Optionally matches a specific room type. Returns room numbers, room types, and status.

propertyId.description: Property identifier (injected by the calling agent from session context)

roomType.description: Optional room type to match (e.g. SUITE, KING_DELUXE, KING_STANDARD).
